title: CORE Mapping
description:
A declarative field-to-field mapping between two CORE DataStructures. Each exported Mapping document carries '$schema': 'https://civitasconnect.digital/core/mapping/v1' so it is self-describing.

Note: the 'x-core-ref' annotations on 'source' and 'target' declare that each value is the CORE URN of a DataStructure (an Element URN is also accepted for backward compatibility); existence is checked by registry-aware services.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this Mapping.

source.description: Versioned CORE URN of the source DataStructure (the structure being read from). An Element URN is also accepted for backward compatibility.

target.description: Versioned CORE URN of the target DataStructure (the structure being written to). An Element URN is also accepted for backward compatibility.

fields.description: Map of target field paths to their field operations.

StructureUrn.description: Versioned CORE URN of a DataStructure that a Mapping binds (an Element URN is also accepted for backward compatibility).

CopyFieldOperation.description: Copies a value from an input field path. The path is given as 'sourcePath' (the mapping editor's field name) or 'input' (legacy alias); at least one must be present.

ConcatFieldOperation.description: Concatenates multiple input field values with an optional separator.

inputs.description: Inputs concatenated in order — each a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

ConstFieldOperation.description: Writes a constant literal value into the target field regardless of source data.

value.description: The constant value. Can be a string, number, or boolean.

valueType.description: Optional editor hint for how to interpret 'value' (e.g. string/number/boolean).

ToStringFieldOperation.description: Converts the input value to its string representation.

input.description: Value to convert — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

ToIntFieldOperation.description: Parses the input value as an integer.

input.description: Value to convert — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

ToFloatFieldOperation.description: Parses the input value as a floating-point number.

input.description: Value to convert — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

ToUuidFieldOperation.description: Converts the input string to a UUID.

input.description: Value to convert — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

ToDateTimeFieldOperation.description: Parses the input string into a date-time value using a date pattern.

input.description: String value to parse — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

pattern.description: Date pattern used to parse the input, e.g. "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX".

ToDateFieldOperation.description: Parses the input string into a date/time value using a date pattern.

input.description: String value to parse — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

pattern.description: Date pattern used to parse the input, e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

FormatFieldOperation.description: Formats the input date/time value into a string using a date pattern.

input.description: Date/time value to format — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

pattern.description: Date pattern used to format the output, e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

GeoPointFieldOperation.description: Builds a GeoJSON-style point from a longitude and latitude input.

lon.description: Longitude — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

lat.description: Latitude — a JSONPath string or a nested operation.

MappingField.description: A field mapping — either a shorthand input path string or a full operation object.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for a copy operation: value is the input path.
